title: Language Models Struggle to Use Representations Learned In-Context
abstract: arXiv:2602.04212v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Though large language models (LLMs) have enabled great success across a wide variety of tasks, they still appear to fall short of one of the loftier goals of artificial intelligence research: creating an artificial system that can adapt its behavior to radically new contexts upon deployment. One important step towards this goal is to create systems that can induce rich representations of data that are seen in-context, and then flexibly deploy these representations to accomplish goals. Recently, Park et al. (2024) demonstrated that current LLMs are indeed capable of inducing such representation from context (i.e., in-context representation learning). The present study investigates whether LLMs can use these representations to complete simple downstream tasks.   We first assess whether open-weights LLMs can use in-context representations for next-token prediction, and then probe models using a novel task, adaptive world modeling.

translated_title: 语言模型难以使用在上下文中学习到的表示
translated_abstract: arXiv:2602.04212v3 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）已在众多任务中取得巨大成功，但它们似乎仍未能实现人工智能研究的更高目标之一：创建一个能够在部署后根据全新情境调整自身行为的人工系统。迈向这一目标的重要一步，是创建能够对上下文中出现的数据归纳出丰富的表示，并灵活运用这些表示来完成目标的系统。最近，Park等人（2024）证明，当前的LLMs确实能够从上下文中归纳出此类表示（即上下文表示学习）。本研究探讨LLMs是否能使用这些表示来完成简单的下游任务。我们首先评估开源权重的LLMs能否使用上下文表示进行下一个词元预测，然后使用一个新颖的任务——自适应世界建模——来对模型进行探测。
tldr: 该研究发现，尽管当前大型语言模型能够从上下文中归纳学习出丰富的数据表示，但在将这些表示灵活运用于下游任务（如下一个词元预测和自适应世界建模）时仍表现不佳。
en_tdlr: This study finds that although current LLMs can induce rich representations of in-context data, they struggle to flexibly use these representations to complete simple downstream tasks such as next-token prediction and adaptive world modeling.
